messages_sender.name: messages_sender
messages_sender.value:
("messages"."from_project" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."sender" IS NULL)
        OR ("messages"."from_project" IS NULL AND "messages"."source" = 'human' AND "messages"."sender" IS NULL)
        OR ("messages"."from_project" IS NULL AND "messages"."source" = 'agent' AND "messages"."sender" IS NOT NULL)

messages_sender_len.name: messages_sender_len
messages_sender_len.value: "messages"."sender" IS NULL OR char_length("messages"."sender") BETWEEN 1 AND 80

report_documents_counts.name: report_documents_counts
report_documents_counts.value: "report_documents"."characters" >= 0 AND ("report_documents"."pages" IS NULL OR "report_documents"."pages" >= 0) AND ("report_documents"."tables" IS NULL OR "report_documents"."tables" >= 0)
